message.content: After describing his preference for branching narratives and multiple endings in games like Detroit: Become Human, Jareth expresses a desire for both intense boss fights and more relaxed gameplay. Specifically, he states, "I loved the feeling of finally overcoming the bosses after all the planning! The visuals and music really amp up the atmosphere, making the battle even more epic. It’s such a rush when you pull off a clutch move and win! Do you all prefer intense boss fights or something more relaxed?" This indicates that Jareth enjoys the adrenaline rush from intense boss fights but also values the relaxation and exploration that comes from less challenging gameplay.
